# stalwart_spam_pyzor (Data Source)

Configures the Pyzor collaborative spam detection service. This singleton object always exists: creating the resource adopts the current server settings and destroying it only removes the resource from state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `allow_count` (Number) The number of times the hash appears in the Pyzor allowlist
- `block_count` (Number) The number of times the hash appears in the Pyzor blocklist
- `enable` (Boolean) Whether to enable the Pyzor classifier. Pyzor is a collaborative, networked system to detect and report spam.
- `host` (String) The hostname of the Pyzor server
- `id` (String) Always `singleton`.
- `port` (Number) The port to connect to the Pyzor server
- `ratio` (Number) The ratio of the number of times the hash appears in the Pyzor allowlist to the blocklist
- `timeout` (Number) The timeout for the Pyzor server. If the server does not respond within this time, the check is considered failed.
